found_values.value: Load at both settings: 4.0 A, the synchroniser's ceiling for a pair, which is the highest current any servo procedure allows (a single servo aborts at 3.0 A). Current limit at both settings: 6.35 A, the top of the TPS55285's IOUT_LIMIT register (0.5 to 6.35 A in 50 mA steps). From the 12 to 20 V DC input both settings run in buck mode. There the average inductor current equals the output current, so 6.35 A stays under the 7 A minimum average inductor current limit. Applied as 'Output current from the DC input' and 'Output current limit' of Servo supply
found_values.source: docs/Servo.md:35 and :68-69 (checkout e13f5f6); TPS55285 data sheet SLVSI72A sections 5.4 (ILIM_AVG 7 A min, 8 A typ), 6.3.12, 7.2, 8.2.2.3 (equation 7: in buck mode the inductor DC current equals the output current), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf (vendors.py fetch, chrome, HTTP 200)

found_values.value: 4.0 A at 8.4 V with 6.0 to 8.4 V at VIN, the same pair ceiling as V109. The TPS55285 delivers it: from 6.0 V at 88.8 % (V111), 4.0 A needs 8.4 x 4.0 / (6.0 x 0.888) = 6.31 A of inductor current, under the 7 A minimum average limit. At that limit the rail gives 4.44 A (7 A min) to 5.07 A (8 A typ) from 6.0 V. The 6.35 A the tree implies would need 10.0 A at 6.0 V, so it is not deliverable there. Applied as 'Output current from the pack at 8.4 V'
found_values.source: docs/Servo.md:68-69 (checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 5.4 (ILIM_AVG) and equation 7, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf; Figure 5-3 for the efficiency

found_values.value: 88.8 %. The data sheet has no curve at 6.0 to 8.4 V in and 8.4 V out. The nearest is Figure 5-3 (VOUT 9 V, FPWM, typical, 25 degC), curve VIN 5 V: 96.0 % at 1 A, 91.5 % at 3 A, 90.1 % at 3.4 A and 88.8 % at 3.8 A, its last point (digitized at 600 dpi from page 9). It is a higher boost ratio with more input current per output ampere than 6.0 V to 8.4 V, so its last point is taken as the lower bound. At a full pack (8.4 V in, unity ratio) the VIN 9 V curve reads 94.9 % at 6 A. Applied as 'Efficiency from the pack'
found_values.source: SLVSI72A Figure 5-3, page 9, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf, rendered with pdftoppm at 600 dpi and read by pixel against the 10 % gridlines and log decades

found_values.value: 20 V steady: the top of the owner's 12 to 20 V DC input. The transient and its duration are not read. No page in the tree states them, and the DC source is not named. R5's input protection, selected in the same task, sets the clamp. For comparison, the TPS55285 stops switching at 22.0 to 23.0 V rising (0.9 V hysteresis), and VIN is rated 27 V absolute maximum. Applied as 'Highest steady VIN'
found_values.source: Research.md:61 (Power decision, owner 2026-09-25, checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 5.1 and 5.4, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: 6.0 V at the pack terminals (F9: 2 x 3.0 V). The drop across R5's pack path (disconnect, source selection, protection) is not read, because R5 selects those parts in the same task. The 4.0 A of V110 holds down to 5.41 V at VIN (7 A minimum average inductor limit, 88.8 %), which leaves 0.59 V for the pack path at about 6.3 to 7 A. Applied as 'Pack input range'
found_values.source: F9 Answer, Research.md:537 (checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 5.4 and equation 7, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: 5.5 V and 8.4 V are nominal set points. The highest voltage allowed at a port's supply pin is the F16 ceiling: 6.0 V in the LV position and 8.7 V in the HV position. The converter holds its set point within +/-1.5 % (VOUT_FULL 9.85 to 10.15 V on the 10 V range), so it reaches up to 5.58 V and 8.53 V before ripple and load steps. The low-voltage servo class is rated 4.8 to 6.0 V (Savox SH-0255MG+). Applied as 'Set point against the ceilings'
found_values.source: F16 Answer, Research.md:544; IOBoard.md:342, :350 (checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 5.4 VOUT_FULL, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf; Savox SH-0255MG+ page 'Operating Voltage (V) 4.8V - 6.0V', https://savox-servo.com/en/product/SH-0255MGplus/savox-servo-sh-0255mg-digital-dc-motor-metal-gear (read 2026-09-29T09:50:42Z)

found_values.value: An output of the I/O expander, with a pull-down resistor that holds EN/UVLO below 0.4 V while that output is an input. The expander resets with the RP2354B (IOBoard.md:340), so an RP2354B reset shuts the converter down, and EN/UVLO below 0.4 V resets every TPS55285 register (6.3.6). A MODE resistor that sets the default OE bit to 0 (0 Ohm for 75h, or 48.7 kOhm for 74h; Table 6-2) keeps the output off after EN rises until firmware writes the set point. An expander output takes none of the 48 GPIO (IOBoard.md:133). Applied as 'Enable off at RP2354B reset' of Servo supply and counted in V119
found_values.source: IOBoard.md:133, :340 (checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 5.4 (VEN_L 0.4 V min, VEN_H 1.03 V max), 6.3.2 Table 6-2, 6.3.6, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: 0 to 50 degC ambient, the owner's one range for the whole IO board (V7 answer). Applied as 'Ambient range' of every R6 function
found_values.source: V7 Answer, Research.md:567 (owner, 2026-09-28; checkout e13f5f6)

found_values.value: 400 kHz. TI recommends 400 kHz or 800 kHz to cut switching loss in high-power use (6.3.7) and selects 400 kHz for its high-current application (8.2.2.1). The inner current loop then needs an inductance above 1.2/fSW = 3.0 uH (8.2.2.3). Applied as 'Switching frequency' of Servo supply and 'Inductance' of Servo supply inductor
found_values.source: SLVSI72A 5.4 (FSW 00b: 360 to 440 kHz), 6.3.7, 8.2.2.1, 8.2.2.3, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: Above 13 A, the TPS55285's cycle-by-cycle peak current limit (typical; the data sheet gives no minimum or maximum). An overload or a short drives the inductor to that limit. The highest peak in operation is 7.97 A: 20 V in, 8.4 V and 6.35 A out, 400 kHz, 4.7 uH less 20 % (equations 5 and 9; 7.65 A at the nominal 4.7 uH). TI's recommended inductors saturate at 15.2 to 17 A (Table 8-2). Applied as 'Saturation current'
found_values.source: SLVSI72A 5.4 (ILIM_PK 13 A typ), 8.2.2.3 equations 5, 7, 9, Table 8-2, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: 26 outputs: 20 port supply switch enables, 5 bias selector controls (R4's found V56: one per multiprotocol port and one for the UART socket) and 1 enable for the servo converter (V115). Two 16-bit expanders give 32 lines, 6 spare. Applied as 'Outputs'
found_values.source: IOBoard.md:348, :383 (checkout e13f5f6); V56 value in results/hardware/research/round1/FU-A3/002-P2-R4.json; V115 above

found_values.value: 400 kHz. The only I2C rate setting in the tree spans 100 to 400 kHz in 100 kHz steps and defaults to 400 kHz. It is labelled for the display's bus, and no other rate is stated. The TPS55285 takes 100 to 1000 kHz. Applied as 'I2C clock'
found_values.source: shared/settings/settings.c:105-107 (checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 5.5 (fSCL 100 to 1000 kHz), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: Yes. The 20 port supply switches are not the servo rail gate. The gate is R3's one high-side switch on the rail, because the Not defeatable rule keeps a gate off the I/O expander that drives the port switches. Applied as 'Not the rail gate': no gate requirement applies to the port switch
found_values.source: R3 row, Research.md:281 (checkout e13f5f6); IOBoard.md:218; R3's found V33, results FU-A3/003-P2-R3.json

found_values.value: 3.0 A continuous: the per-servo current ceiling at which the procedures abort at once, checked at every sample. Applied as 'Continuous current' at 50 degC ambient
found_values.source: docs/Servo.md:35 (checkout e13f5f6)

found_values.value: Yes. Each port switch limits its own current at a value whose whole tolerance band lies between 3.0 A and 6.35 A. At or above 3.0 A, the firmware abort acts first on a normal overload. Under 6.35 A, the shared rail's limit, one shorted port does not pull the other 19 ports into the converter's current limit. Applied as 'Own current limit'
found_values.source: docs/Servo.md:35; IOBoard.md:536 (checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 6.3.12, 7.2, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: 590 mV across the switch at 3.0 A. The LV setting's low end is 5.42 V (5.5 V less 1.5 %). The lowest operating voltage of the low-voltage servo class is 4.8 V (Savox SH-0255MG+), which leaves 0.62 V. The 10 mOhm port monitor shunt takes 30 mV of that at 3.0 A. Connector and trace drops are round 2 and not counted. Applied as 'Voltage drop'
found_values.source: SLVSI72A 5.4 VOUT_FULL, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf; Savox SH-0255MG+ page, https://savox-servo.com/en/product/SH-0255MGplus/savox-servo-sh-0255mg-digital-dc-motor-metal-gear; IOBoard.md:351 (10 mOhm shunt, checkout e13f5f6)

found_values.value: Under 5 mA at 8.4 V: the quiescent current of the lightest servo read, Savox SH-0255MG+, is 5 mA. An open port has to leak less than the lightest load draws at idle. Applied as 'Off-state leakage'
found_values.source: Savox SH-0255MG+ page 'Quiescent Current (mA) 5', https://savox-servo.com/en/product/SH-0255MGplus/savox-servo-sh-0255mg-digital-dc-motor-metal-gear; shared/ui/stub_screen.c:57 (signal-only mode, checkout e13f5f6)

found_values.value: Yes, with the pin up to 12 V, both while the switch is on and while it is off. An ESC on a port drives its BEC onto the port's supply pin (docs/OpenYGE.md:253, BEC setting). YGE's BECs are adjustable from 5.5 to 8.4 V, and the Saphir series reaches 12 V. Applied as 'Reverse blocking'
found_values.source: docs/OpenYGE.md:253 (checkout e13f5f6); YGE LV products page ('The voltage is adjustable from 5.5V to 8.4V, with the Saphir series up to 12V'; Saphir 125/155 V2 BEC 5.5-12V), https://www.yge.de/en/products/low-voltage-lv (vendors.py fetch, chrome, HTTP 200)

found_values.value: 5 ms. No source names a deadline from an RP2354B reset; R1 did not find V1 either (FU-A4 return). The specification's only opening time for a power switch is 5 ms from the enable node falling (servo rail gate, IOBoard.md:188). It is applied here from the reset to every port switch open. Applied as 'Opening time after reset'
found_values.source: IOBoard.md:188, :340 (checkout e13f5f6); V1 value in results FU-A4/002-P2-R1.json

found_values.value: LV: may cut off from 5.58 V and must cut off by 6.00 V. HV: may cut off from 8.53 V and must cut off by 8.70 V. The lower edges are the converter's highest set point at 5.5 V and 8.4 V (+1.5 %). The upper edges are F16. Output ripple and load-step overshoot depend on output capacitors selected in round 2; they are not included and narrow the band further. The HV band is +/-0.99 % about 8.615 V. Applied as 'LV trip band' and 'HV trip band'
found_values.source: F16 Answer, Research.md:544 (checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 5.4 VOUT_FULL, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: Not found. No primary source read gives a time a servo survives above its rating or a cut-off time for the ceiling. For reference, the TPS55285 slews its output at 1.25 to 10 mV/us when its set point changes (register 03h, SR bits; 2.5 mV/us default). Recorded as not found; no cut-off time is applied as a pass or fail limit
found_values.source: F16 Answer, Research.md:544 (checkout e13f5f6); SLVSI72A 7.3 Table 7-4, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: The port stays off until an operator or firmware action. The tree's rule is 'Every stop latches; nothing re-arms on its own'. A cut-off that reconnects by itself when the rail falls back would re-arm the port on its own. Applied as 'Latch until action'
found_values.source: STATUS.md:340 (checkout e13f5f6)

found_values.value: 8.4 V: 2 x 4.2 V. The 18650 cells of an S9 maker charge CC-CV to 4.2 V (Molicel INR-18650-P28A, 'Cell Voltage Charge 4.2 V'). Applied as the top of 'Pack input range'
found_values.source: Molicel INR-18650-P28A Product Data Sheet v1.3, https://www.molicel.com/wp-content/uploads/INR18650P28A_1.3_Product-Data-Sheet-of-INR-18650-P28A-80093.pdf (vendors.py fetch, chrome, HTTP 200); S9 Answer, Research.md:119

found_values.value: In boost mode the pack current is the inductor current, and the average inductor current limit clamps it: 8 A typical, 7 A minimum, no maximum stated. At V110's 4.0 A load the pack current at 6.0 V is 6.31 A (88.8 %). 9.9 A is not reached while the limit holds, but no maximum in the data sheet rules out a limit above 9.9 A. Applied as 'Pack current at 6.0 V' and reported for R5 and R7
found_values.source: SLVSI72A 5.4 (ILIM_AVG 7 A min, 8 A typ, VIN 8 V, VOUT 15 V, 400 kHz), 6.3.9, equation 7, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: Not found. No primary source read gives the input capacitance of a servo or of a BEC-fed receiver load on a port, or a peak inrush the rail may give. Recorded as not found. The candidates' adjustable slew rate (dVdt capacitor) is recorded, so round 2 can set the inrush once a figure exists
found_values.source: docs/Servo.md, IOBoard.md:531, :536 (checkout e13f5f6); no servo maker page read gives an input capacitance

found_values.value: 6.35 A. The TPS55285's output current limit is enabled at reset (IOUT_LIMIT bit 7 = 1) and responds after 128 us at the reset value of OCP_DELAY (00b); firmware keeps both. The port switch's own limit of V123 acts first on a single shorted port. Applied as 'Current into a shorted port'
found_values.source: SLVSI72A 7.2 Table 7-3 and 7.3 Table 7-4, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: Cut-off state: yes. V130 has firmware hold a cut port off, so the RP2354B has to see the cut-off. It reads it from the port monitor's bus-voltage reading, which falls to about 0 V behind an open switch; no added pin is needed. Jumper position: no. The setup screen lists the ceilings as set in hardware, and no source asks firmware to read the jumper. Applied as 'Cut-off state readable'
found_values.source: shared/ui/stub_screen.c:56; STATUS.md:340; IOBoard.md:351 (port monitor per port, checkout e13f5f6)

found_values.value: 20 V. The TPS55285 programs up to 15 V, and its output overvoltage protection trips at 110.5 to 120 % of the set point, up to 18 V. A converter set to its highest target (about 21.3 V) or failed through passes up to its input, and the DC input reaches 20 V (V112). The same figure R3 found for the servo rail gate (V44). Applied as 'Input withstand' of Port supply switch and Port voltage ceiling
found_values.source: SLVSI72A 5.2 (VOUT 0.8 to 15 V), 5.4 (VVOUT_OVP_FB 110.5 to 120 %), 7.1, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf; Research.md:61 (DC input 12 to 20 V); R3's V44, results FU-A3/003-P2-R3.json
